status: Fixed authored recipe only; not evaluated, constructed or fitted
scope: Five main outer panels, five separate lining panels and plain free-edge joining rims; no finished garment extensions

frame.units: native world units, no metre/calibration assertion
frame.convention: wearer right negativeX, front negativeY, up positiveZ; authored observer convention
frame.design_basis: Literal design coordinates guided by stored source frame/bounds only; not fitted source skin/joints/section/pixels

operator: OPERATOR.md exact S definition; no named-upstream/equivalence claim

curve_primitives.cubic: (1-t)^3 P0 + 3(1-t)^2 t P1 + 3(1-t)t^2 P2 + t^3 P3; endpoint references authoritative, explicit exact endpoint returns
curve_primitives.concat: segments k=0..n-1 on [k/n,(k+1)/n], local q=n*t-k; exact knots return shared endpoint owner; no derivative continuity claim
curve_primitives.mirror_left: M=diag(-1,1,1) applied to the entire right design, with R point/curve ids replaced by L; same t; no body-symmetry assertion
curve_primitives.ring: Q + rd*cos(2*pi*u)*d + rf*sin(2*pi*u)*f, u in[0,1]; u=1 canonicalized to u=0 before floating evaluation
curve_primitives.ring_axes_left: mirror_left of right axes; normalized orthogonal by the explicit algebraic definitions, not source-body axes

I.role: independently literal inner main lining; not generated by normal offset/shrink

sampling_and_welding.mandatory: All old t=i/16, i0..16, retained. An edge with n16/32/48 intervals uses t=j/n; mandatory index j=i*(n/16). Refinements fixed, not a fit search.
sampling_and_welding.seam: Opposite aliases share canonical curve/sample owner, reverse index n-j; all source seam pairs require equal n. Corner endpoint aliases weld by named owner, not nearest-position tolerance.
sampling_and_welding.internal: FR and FL upper.B/lower.T share crossFront at identical j/32; B upper.B/lower.T share backCross j/48; each sleeve lower.top/upper.bottom shares elbow j/32.
sampling_and_welding.periodic: Sleeve u=1 uses u=0 owner; rows at both sides share underSleeve owner with global v=1-t. Cap front/rear split u=0.5 is shared T owner; u0/u1 shared U.
sampling_and_welding.layers: Each canonical owner is prefixed O or I; no outer/inner weld even if positions coincide. Same named edges and refinements correspond, not actual geometric separation.
sampling_and_welding.precision: F64 computations, explicit exact endpoint/canonical-boundary returns, one final F32 coordinate cast; max absolute component cast error1e-7. Actual buffers/precision not tested in this slice.
sampling_and_welding.quad_split: For parametric positive winding, local cell a=(i,j),b=(i+1,j),c=(i+1,j+1),d=(i,j+1): triangles[a,b,c],[a,c,d]. Negative winding reverses each triple. Inner layer reverses stated outer_chart_winding. Deterministic one diagonal, no feedback flips.
sampling_and_welding.no_acceptance: These are source responsibilities, not executed incidence/area/winding/contact or physical proof. Any actual degeneracy/fold/invalidity stops its later trial.

main_rims.surface: J(t,w)=(1-w)*O.edge(t)+w*I.edge(t), w0outer/w1inner; one cell across width, nmatchingedge intervals along t
main_rims.triangles: For each directed free edge sample i: [O(i+1),O(i),I(i)] and [O(i+1),I(i),I(i+1)]. Outer boundary opposed; inner layer already reversed. Reuse corner owners across neighboring rim strips.
main_rims.scope: Plain closure strips only; not authored collar, elastic cuff/hem, facing/zip/guard/pocket bags or a proved physical lining wall

extensions.geometry: Excluded/future: collar, hemtrim, bothcuffs, bothfacings/ziphalves, leftguard, bothpocketmouths/bags
extensions.pocket_marks: No holes or cuts in main mesh; original proposed marks not metric/UV placement

qualification_hold: Boundary proof is real algebra only
All full-body/outer/inner/rim/self contacts and clearance UNKNOWN
Independent body coverage/exposure domain and fullsurface qualification still required
One fixed preset; no old harmonic/source-loop/normal/ease/phase/lighting rescue or parameter retune
